visual_review.method: Inspected exact encoded grip/wrist crop sheet through entry, edge-on, front-facing and held reveal; inspected six full-scene frames.
visual_review.findings: Frame no longer occludes/cuts through the drawn fingers mid-turn. Wrist remains connected in inspected poses; final frame score is unobstructed and close-up excludes neighboring call-tile slivers.
visual_review.limits: Small light fringe and stylized fixed finger grip remain in reused source contours. Seated movement is bounded; no extreme-pose or benchmark-level claim. Normal-speed aesthetic and listening review remain pending.
